title: Black Butler
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In Victorian London, twelve-year-old Earl Ciel Phantomhive investigates crimes for Queen Victoria as her 'Watchdog'. After his parents were murdered and he was abused by a demon-worshiping cult, Ciel made a contract with the demon Sebastian, who serves as his butler and will consume his soul once Ciel has his revenge. Later arcs reveal secrets about Ciel's twin and pit him against a grim reaper's reanimation schemes.
life_message: It holds up pride, self-command and seeing one's chosen purpose through to the end, whatever it costs.

content.note: Murders, human sacrifice, sword, gun and chainsaw fights with spraying blood; Sebastian kills cultists and assassins (Wikipedia; CSM on the anime; AniList Crime 90%, Assassins).
Demonic contract for a child's soul, cult ritual, reanimated corpses (Wikipedia; CSM; AniList Demons 95%).
Ciel's backstory includes sexual abuse (implied); suggestive scenes between Ciel and adult men and sexual innuendo that reviewers found uncomfortable (Wikipedia; CSM; Manga Bookshelf).
CSM lists 'damn', 'hell' and occasional 'f--k' in the anime; manga level to verify.
Smoking, drinking and an opium/drug-dealing storyline per CSM on the anime (to verify in manga).
Child abuse trauma and a life organized around revenge (Wikipedia; CSM; AniList Revenge 93%, Orphan).
A child 'selling his soul' to a demon; ruthless and deceptive hero (CSM role models).
Ciel runs the Funtom toy and confectionery company in story (to verify); large merchandise franchise.
